result.title: DreamTour: Layout Steering for Training-Free World Exploration
result.summary: Video diffusion and world models generate plausible videos but do not reliably match the requested camera direction and travel distance. We present DreamTour, a training-free framework that generates camera tours from a single image with more accurate control over camera motion. DreamTour first uses a frozen image inpainting prior to extend the photograph beyond its original field of view while preserving the input pixels. Depth-based rendering of this extended scene along the requested camera path produces approximate target views that serve as spatial guidance. We introduce Layout Steering, which aligns early video latents with these views through decaying low-frequency corrections, leaving later denoising to refine appearance and dynamics. For longer tours, we autoregressively generate the video segments, repeating guidance construction from each segment's final frame to maintain camera control across the full trajectory. DreamTour improves directional accuracy and travel calibration on VBench while maintaining competitive video quality. On WorldScore, it strengthens camera control and scene consistency across chained movements. Together, these results demonstrate that training-free spatial guidance enables more accurate and consistent camera control in pretrained video diffusion and world models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需训练的 DreamTour 框架：先用冻结的图像修复先验扩展视野，再按给定相机路径做深度渲染得到近似目标视角，并以「Layout Steering」在早期去噪阶段用衰减的低频修正对齐视频 latent，长轨迹则自回归分段生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以几何渲染的近似视角作为空间指导、按去噪步衰减地修正早期 latent」可供核查是否适用于向 LVR 内部状态注入视觉证据及其强度调度，但属视频生成任务，与 VLM 推理的联系需人工判断。
